content.text: Many digital creators face obstacles when attempting to sell ebooks due to heavy fees and restrictions from platforms like Stripe and PayPal. In countries where these services are unavailable, the challenge intensifies. However, by leveraging blockchain technology and a decentralized [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/usdt-payment-gateways-digital-products-every-detail-you-2|COREMERCH guide to payment]] structure, you can set up a sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-cloudflare-r2-digital-product-storage-2|The Full]] that allows you to accept [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/bitcoin-payments-digital-downloads-explained-digital-creators-stripe-7|bitcoin]] for your ebook sales with minimal fees. This guide provides a step-by-step approach to establishing your digital storefront without relying on conventional payment processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/real-architecture-behind-automated-digital-product-delivery-crypto-3. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail: Bitcoin ebook

Traditional platforms like Gumroad impose high fees, charging up to 10% on each sale. In contrast, using NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions incurs only a 0.5% fee, significantly increasing your profit margin. For example, if you sell 100 ebooks priced at $97, the fee difference between Gumroad and NOWPayments retains an additional $921 in your pocket. This sovereign approach eliminates dependency on restrictive platforms, giving you complete control over your sales and customer data.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Setting up your digital commerce stack requires a few essential components. First, you need a reliable hosting solution such as GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for serving your site. Next, choose a backend logic solution like Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers for handling transactions and automating delivery. You'll also require NOWPayments for processing Bitcoin payments seamlessly. Lastly, establish a method for storing your order data, ideally using Supabase or Google Sheets. Prepare these tools for a smooth deployment.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To create an efficient payment and delivery pipeline, start by configuring NOWPayments for Bitcoin transactions. Follow their integration guide to connect your online store with the payment processor. Next, automate delivery with Google Apps Script or Cloudflare Workers, ensuring that customers receive their ebooks immediately upon payment confirmation. Use webhooks to trigger automatic delivery, providing a seamless experience for your users. This setup guarantees that you can accept payments and deliver products without manual intervention.
Retain 99.5% of your sales revenue with NOWPayments.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once your infrastructure is set up, it's time to go live. Publish your site on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, ensuring that all links and payment buttons are functional. Test your payment processing with a small transaction to confirm everything operates as intended. Monitor the transaction status through NOWPayments to verify that payments are processed accurately. Remember to communicate with your customers about their order status, enhancing their trust in your platform.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

After successfully processing transactions, consider strategies for scaling your operations. You can expand your product offerings by adding more ebooks or digital assets. Leverage social media and digital marketing to reach a wider audience. Monitor data analytics to understand customer behavior and refine your sales approach. As your business grows, ensure that your infrastructure can handle increased traffic and transactions without compromising performance.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

Selling digital products without PayPal or Stripe is not a compromise — it is an upgrade for creators in restricted markets. The conventional platforms that seem like the standard path come with payout delays, geographic restrictions, platform fees of 5 to 10 percent, and the permanent risk of account suspension. A sovereign stack has none of these constraints. Your product page loads on Cloudflare Pages. Your buyer pays in USDT or Bitcoin through a NOWPayments checkout with live price feeds and QR code generation. Your backend verifies the payment on-chain and sends the download link within 30 seconds.
Eliminate platform dependency and own your data.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Every digital product type — ebook, course, template, font, preset, beat, plugin, software license — works with the same sovereign commerce infrastructure. You build the product. NOWPayments handles the checkout. Your backend handles the delivery. You keep 99.5% of every sale. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 has COREMERCH deploy the complete stack under your accounts in 48 hours. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 gives you everything you need to build it yourself. Both paths lead to a store you own completely. See both at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Build your product before you build your store — the product is the point, not the infrastructure. Once your product is ready and in delivery-ready format, create your NOWPayments account and configure wallet addresses. Choose Stack 01 for self-deployment following the Blueprint, or Stack 02 for COREMERCH deployment. Upload your product file to Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 and note the file path. Configure the product in your backend with the file path, USD price, and delivery email template. Build your product page on the storefront with clear product description, pricing in USD, and the checkout flow. Run a complete mainnet test. Check that the download link works and expires correctly after the configured time period.
